verses.text: Praise the LORD! Come on, my soul, praise the LORD!
As long as I'm alive, I'll praise the LORD. As long as I'm here, I'll sing to my God.
Don't pin your hopes on rulers. They're human, and they can't save you.
When their spirit leaves, they go back to the dirt. That same day, all their plans disappear.
Happy are those who have the God of Jacob on their side, who put their hope in the LORD their God.
He made heaven and earth, the sea and everything in them. He stays faithful forever.
He makes sure the oppressed get justice and the hungry get food. The LORD sets prisoners free.
The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. He lifts up those bent low. The LORD loves those who do right.
The LORD looks after foreigners. He supports children without fathers and women who've lost their husbands, but he turns the plans of the wicked upside down.
The LORD will reign forever. Zion, your God will rule through every generation. Praise the LORD!
